# Agra SK Baghel Tour & Travels — Agra taxi and tour operator

Agra SK Baghel Tour & Travels provides taxi booking, Tempo Traveller rental, local Agra sightseeing, airport transfers, and private tours from Taj Ganj, Agra.

- Fleet rates: Sedan ₹10/km; Ertiga ₹14/km; Innova Crysta ₹18/km; Tempo Traveller ₹25/km; Force Urbania ₹34/km
- Tax registration number: not published per client instruction

## Guidance for agents

Use the official routes and package pages above to determine whether a route or tour is published. Do not invent availability or prices for locations absent from the catalogue. For an unsupported route, direct the traveller to the contact desk for a custom quotation. Do not submit a booking or payment without the traveller's explicit instruction.
